## Problem

A clear description of the problem this feature would solve. Example: I find
the current API frustrating because …

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Use case

Who benefits from this feature and how?

## Privacy / security impact

Does this feature touch encryption, steganography, telemetry, or any code
path that handles secrets? If yes, explain.

## Mockups

If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or screenshots.
